$comment: The type errors the TRANSLATED tree is EXPECTED to have, as reason-tagged patterns rather than a count. A line matching one is allowed; anything else fails the lane. Patterns, not numbers, because the number alone cannot say WHY, and a new failure of a known shape must still be visible. When a limitation is fixed, delete its row in the commit that fixes it. Read by scripts/core/drizzle-translate.mjs (host) and container/drizzle-e2e/shared/run-suite.mjs (container).

allowed.reason: A mysql index HINT is a query-side value: `.useIndex(idx)` wants drizzle's own index builder, while the same index is declared in the table's extraConfig as a recorder. One binding cannot be both, so the hint stays on drizzle's side of the boundary and its tests are on the skip list.

allowed.pattern: error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, but got 0
allowed.reason: vitest's expectTypeOf(x).toEqualTypeOf<T>() gained a required argument after the version drizzle's suites were written against. Nothing to do with the recorders.

allowed.pattern: error TS2344: Type '.*' does not satisfy the constraint
allowed.reason: drizzle's own Expect<Equal<...>> and vitest's toEqualTypeOf are IDENTITY checks against plain types (string, number, Date). Our columns carry runtype format brands, so `string & FormatBrand<...>` can never be identical to `string` — even though it is assignable to it, which is what consumers actually need. Three of these also report `date` as `never`: that one is a checker limit in a 6500-line file with ~100 slim tables, not a defect — the same 70-column table, verbatim, resolves `date` correctly in a file of its own.

allowed.pattern: error TS2769: No overload matches this call
allowed.reason: drizzle's `.overridingSystemValue()` re-admits an always-identity column to an insert. The slim table's synthesised drizzle config reports identity as undefined (nothing else in drizzle's typing branches on it), so the override has nothing to re-admit.

environmental.pattern: Cannot find module|Cannot find name|Could not find a declaration|implicitly has an|side-effect import
environmental.reason: Packages the HOST lane does not install (dockerode, get-port, @types/node, dotenv). The container lane installs all of them, so these never appear there.
